instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Core Systems.com is a custom software development house specializing in building bespoke ERP, CRM, and workflow automation solutions for mid-market manufacturing and logistics companies across North America. The full-stack team of 22 developers leverages modern cloud infrastructure to deliver scalable enterprise applications while maintaining specialized expertise in legacy system integrations.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base – our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: Despite low competitive pressure, the high regulatory environment necessitates significant upfront investment in compliance features. Furthermore, internal inertia around shifting away from custom development creates friction for rapid digital adoption.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

opportunities.title: Low-Code Platform Expansion into Adjacent Logistics Verticals
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing full-stack engineering team to build standardized low-code modules allows for faster product iteration and cost reduction within current operational frameworks. This incrementally diversifies our portfolio by allowing us to address smaller, adjacent market needs without massive architectural overhaul.

first_actions: Audit existing core ERP features suitable for no-code wrapper implementation.
Allocate 1 full squad team (5 engineers) to a low-code pilot project focusing on supply chain visibility.
Draft a budget request for platform tooling and 3 months of dedicated R&D time.
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful MVP launch with 5 paying customers in the logistics vertical within Q3.
milestones: MVP development and compliance review initiation (Month 3).

opportunities.title: Transition to Vertical SaaS Platform Model via AI Integration
opportunities.rationale: To achieve true diversification and break revenue concentration, we must move beyond bespoke development into a scalable subscription-based platform. This radical shift involves building an AI-driven predictive maintenance module that can be offered as a standalone service or product line, capturing recurring revenue.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated 'Future Ventures' squad with seed funding allocation ($50k).
Conduct market sizing for predictive maintenance solutions in manufacturing.
Develop a detailed regulatory impact assessment for AI data usage.
resources_needed: External legal counsel specializing in manufacturing compliance.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 2 pilot contracts for the new AI-driven module by end of year.
milestones: Platform architecture finalized and secured funding (Month 6).

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated 'Diversification Task Force' to develop 3 distinct non-core market entry strategies.
Conduct a deep technical audit of current bespoke systems versus low-code viability for immediate product line expansion.
Finalize the business case and budget proposal for the AI-driven predictive maintenance initiative to be presented at the formal committee meeting.

key_weaknesses: Rigid and slow innovation cycle hampered by complex, 3-4 stakeholder approval chains for funding.
High dependence on bespoke custom development limits scalability and rapid diversification.
Partial innovation maturity means the '20% time' policy is inconsistently applied across all squads.
